endorsements.quote: Because missing data are so prevalent in many healthcare applications, it is also important to test how robust a model's performance is to missing inputs.

Quantifying model performance and testing the model on independent datasets allows users to assess the accuracy of prognostic data, and continuously monitoring deployed models reinforces the reliability of these AI models.

unlisted_practices: Invest in cybersecurity to protect the data integrity of digital twins.
Continuously monitor deployed AI models to reinforce their reliability.
Establish robust procedures for validating, updating with new data, and applying models, considering the context of use to control risks.
Provide explainability metrics such as SHAP to assess model robustness for regulatory review.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/commentary article discussing the regulatory outlook and pathways to increase trust and adoption of AI-generated digital twins through clinical trial applications.
